summary_1line: Explains cyclical creation, origins of knowledge and sciences, evolution of elements and senses from Prakriti, and the immortal Soul acting through bodies and karma.

image_candidates.scene_text: A single lamp lights thousands of other lamps in darkness, symbolizing primordial matter giving rise to countless beings.
Within a human body shaped like a nine-doored temple, a radiant inner soul illuminates the senses like a lamp.
Rishis in deep penance recover the lost Vedas at the dawn of a new cosmic age after universal dissolution.
